name: J.E. Irausquin boulevard
geo_source: OSM J.E. Irausquin centreline and amenity=parking polygons
ref_sources: Boulevard matched to street level along J.E. Irausquin: white edge lines and a dashed centre line, a red cycle track on the beach side outside the sidewalk, blue-roofed bus shelters at the public stretches, royal palms and sea grape on the verge, stall paint on the existing lots, open canvas pavilions and showers at Eagle Beach plus a lighter set toward Manchebo and Druif, and yellow turtle-nesting boards on the sand. The class-3 road shader already fades a dash into the asphalt; these ribbons sit just above it. Overpass was not reachable, so the shelters sit at the public accesses rather than on a fresh bus_stop extract. Geometry and the sign textures are original.
